pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark patches with medium-smooth edge gradients. Patch area is largest on the upper neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented regions on the hindquarters and lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected network of light-colored pelage forming a continuous topological graph. Nodes are characterized by 3-way and 4-way junctions. Pathways maintain consistent pixel thickness across the neck, with slight widening observed on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured mane along the dorsal neck line exhibiting a low-amplitude jagged silhouette with high-frequency vertical projections against the background.
